hosting: The production service runs on Amazon Web Services (AWS) in us-west-2 (Oregon).
incidents: Customers are notified within 24 hours after confirmation of a security incident affecting their data. The incident commander sends an initial email and daily updates until resolution.
backups: Encrypted daily backups are stored in AWS us-east-1 (Northern Virginia) and retained for 30 days. Restore tests are performed quarterly.
monitoring: Application performance monitoring and infrastructure alerting run continuously. Customer-facing uptime checks run every minute.
